title: Claude 3.5 Sonnet Artifacts: How to Build Web Apps in Minutes
hook: What if you could build and test complete interactive web tools directly inside your AI chat without writing a single line of boilerplate code?

scenes.narration: What if you could build and test complete interactive web apps directly inside your AI chat without writing a single line of boilerplate code?
Anthropic recently introduced Artifacts in Claude 3.5 Sonnet, transforming simple conversational text into a dedicated dynamic side-by-side workspace.
Instead of burying lengthy code snippets in chat history, Artifacts render live JavaScript, SVG diagrams, and React components right on your screen.
Let us explore exactly how you can start using this feature today, step by step.
To begin, open Claude dot A I and toggle the Artifacts option on in the Feature Preview settings.
Next, type a concrete prompt such as build a responsive mortgage calculator with interactive sliders.
Within seconds, Claude generates the complete application on the right panel while keeping the dialogue open on the left.
You can immediately interact with the buttons, adjust variables, or ask Claude to iterate and add dark mode support.
While this drastically accelerates prototyping, keep in mind that complex backend database operations still require custom server architecture.
In summary, Artifacts make rapid UI prototyping faster and more intuitive than ever before for creators and engineers alike.

description:
Discover how to use Claude 3.5 Sonnet Artifacts to rapidly prototype and test interactive web tools, diagrams, and components in real time.

In this tutorial, we break down what Artifacts are, how to enable them on your account, and walk through a step-by-step example building an interactive web tool directly in the Claude workspace.
